lite_mode.title: Lite Mode
lite_mode.brief: Lite mode reduces overheating and power consumption while using apps by lowering CPU and component frequencies. This setting applies to all apps when enabled.

disable_tweaks.title: Disable Tweaks
disable_tweaks.brief: When enabled, this setting turns off all built-in performance optimizations on LUMina Tweaks, allowing you to use this module strictly as a host for Add-on modules.

device_mitigation.title: Device Mitigation
device_mitigation.brief: Device mitigation disables potentially incompatible tweaks for specific devices. Keep it disabled unless you have problems.
